Based on the sources, the park that is 3112 acres and was created by the wave action of Lake Erie over 11,000 years is Presque Isle State Park. The [Presque Isle State Park] source states it is a "3112 acre Pennsylvania state park," and the [History of Presque Isle] source states it "was created by the wave action of Lake Erie over the course of the 11,000 years."

Final answer: Presque Isle State Park
